scientific_integrity: Proof reconstructed and two-point sampling normalization checked; separate Cartesian simulation and numerical integral tests pass. Prior conical unfolding and antipodal geodesic formulas explicitly excluded from novelty claim.
scientific_limitations: Only right circular cone sidewalls, fixed 0<q<1, two independent area-uniform points. Endpoint law nonuniform near q=0 or q=1; exact full survival expressed by quadrature. Originality conditional on searchable literature; no independent validation.
title: Exact stretch distribution and sharp extreme distortion on a circular-cone sidewall
